frontDevelopmentPhase.title: Exercices, evaluations et tutos-videos
frontDevelopmentPhase.goal: Developper le catalogue pedagogique, recherche, reponses, corrections, solutions, commentaires et scores.

allowedMocksUntilDependenciesExist.item: Financial costs can use settings from finance phase or mock defaults in test.
Open activities generated by corrections can be asserted through mocked learning-activity-service until next phase.

frontTests.item: Student searches and opens an exercise.
Student uploads an answer and requests correction.
Teacher uploads exercise with required solution in first version.
Evaluation attempt blocks solution until completed.

apiGatewayImpact.item: Review body-size limits for image/text uploads.

definitionOfDone.item: Correction/solution flows emit states for learning activities.

frontDevelopmentPhase.workingRule: Developper par tranche verticale: API minimale reelle, ecran utilisable, tests front, verification navigateur, puis phase suivante.
